Solara — (9.7) SYZYGY

VEGA

"Vega — we were lost"

[Verse 1]

Three of them — the camp behind them burning

280 behind that — they walked forward

Because forward was the only direction left

Day one: nothing — Day two: nothing

Day three: Aldric checked the map

The map said nothing

The map had never said nothing before

[Pre-Chorus]

“The map shows no level” — “We are going the right way”

“How do you know” — “I know”

“The map says nothing” — “The map is wrong”

Aldric looked at Void — Aldric looked at the map — kept walking

[Chorus]

Vega — we were lost

Vega — nothing on the map

Vega — she cannot reach anyone

Three in the empty — moving anyway

Vega — we are going somewhere — we have to be

[Verse 2]

Solara tried her council — silence

She tried Fate — silence

She tried Time — silence

She stood still in a place with no level

No system — no fold number

Just the three of them

And the dark between things

And Void looking confident

“Are you actually sure,” said Solara

“Yes,” said Void

“About what, specifically”

He considered this — “The direction”

“Which direction” — “This one”

Aldric checked the map again — still wrong — kept walking

[Bridge — VEGA]

Then: light — not the wrong kind — not fire

A star. Present. Old. Amused.

“You are not of the council”

“No — we are—” [Aldric] “We are stranded” [Void]

“That is also true”

“How did you come to be here”

“A trap. Level 280.”

“You entered 280”

“Yes”

“280 has not had a level in four thousand years”

Pause — “We know that now”

Vega tilted — the star equivalent of a head tilt

“You seek a way back to your systems”

“Yes”

“I can take you to the nearest one I know”

“What do you call it”

“The Place With The Loud Ones”

Void: “That is not a level designation”

“I do not use your designations”

“What do the loud ones sound like”

Vega made a sound — it was a cluck

Aldric and Solara looked at each other

Void: “We accept”

[Final Chorus]

Vega — she takes us somewhere

Vega — the map doesn’t know this place

Vega — the nearest level she knows

Is the place with the loud ones

[Outro — FOLD 7]

The warp was quick — the landing was not

Three of them — in a field

Warm light — grass

And chickens — many chickens

One chicken looked at Solara

Solara looked at the chicken

Aldric checked the map — FOLD 7

Void: “This is not a level”

Aldric: “This is Fold 7”

Solara: “Lorn was watching this place the entire time”

“Yes” — “During the meetings” — “During every meeting”

One chicken walked over Aldric’s map

It had more context now — Lorn had been right about that

Solara sat down in Fold 7

Surrounded by chickens

No council — no signal — no orb

Just Void, Aldric, and the loudest level Vega knew

“Alright,” she said — “Now what
